purpose: Smallest read-only pinned R7-compatible adapter to accept new selected public consequences without modifying frozen native R7; source-only engineering, not original-world science.

input_contract.selected_action: int 0..2, committed BEFORE source action executes
input_contract.public_after: int 0..255, received ONLY after the selected source action completes
input_contract.session_boundary: explicit public episode reset, no world/source identity or rule labels
input_contract.hidden_inputs: none; no rewards, goal labels, unselected alternatives, private graph or evaluator future state

candidate.mode: Optional composition-oriented confidence-gated per-public-state/action transition cache; frozen original R7 checkpoint held byte-identical as historical reference but never used as a prediction oracle for an unfamiliar session.
candidate.memory: max 64 observed (before,action) contexts, last 8 selected feedback outcomes per context, deterministic insertion/retention; no eviction or silent memory overwrite; bounded snapshots
candidate.learning: retain only actual selected public after state, bounded FIFO; prior outcomes remain in immutable native base; no unobserved action effects filled in
candidate.predict: No prediction until >=3 same-session, same-public-before/action outcomes and the most frequent after has quantized Beta(1,1) posterior (k+1)/(n+2)>=0.75. Ties and contradictory evidence abstain. For multistep predictions each intermediate selected-action/public-state context must be supported, otherwise abstain.
candidate.abstention: UNKNOWN for insufficient support, changed semantics, ambiguous results, unsupported action or missing future transition; never call old R7 world-keyed prediction as if valid for new source.
candidate.custody: commit-before-feedback, exact before/action match, one feedback per commit, reject snapshot with pending source event; save source-base SHA and bounded adapter canonical SHA; fresh process restore fail closed on tamper or foreign base
candidate.session: Start of new public episode resets only current session history and pending action; preserves frozen original R7 checkpoint. No attribution of generalization to a new source world.

control.type: Independent conventional categorical Beta(1,1) frequent-outcome tabular learner, identical selected action/state/after input, last-eight per-pair window and capacity, >=3 support/0.75 threshold, abstention and exact tie. No private state.
control.comparison: all actual source-free scored forecasts after each observation, agreement, abstention, learned transitions and multi-step composition; if identical classify mechanical source-only parity, not scientific advantage.

tests: source file Git blob and platform line-ending identity
base immutable after incoming selected feedback
3 repeated genuinely observed new effects and subsequent supported public-conditioned two-step composition
foreign base or corrupt checkpoint fail closed
fresh OS process source-bound cold restore
source-only conventional control matches all predictions
negative_conditions: No original Farama/Pycolab engine steps or protected first use
no owner scheduler/runner/queue or FORGE F139 changes
no native source-owned R7 mutation or new controller
no source identities, graph, goal, outcome labels in inputs
no superiority claims for an equal-data count learner
strict full FORGE qualification separately required; do not waive
classification: ENGINEERING_SEAM_ONLY until actual independently authorized source-owner original-world tasks and strong trained controls demonstrate learning and goal transfer.
